injuryArticles.headline: Mississippi State OL DJ Chester out vs. Texas in latest hit to offense
injuryArticles.description: Mississippi State, two days after losing starting QB Kamario Taylor for the season, ruled out starting left guard DJ Chester for Saturday's game against Texas.
